title: Deliver run gates to Telegram through the RunRoom pending store
description: The return arrow: a cloud run must be able to reach its human. When the orchestrator parks a question or an approval gate, it lands in the RunRoom pending store and is delivered on the channel the submission chose, reusing the existing internal/operator/telegram machinery and its paired-operator rule. Answering from the phone resolves it through the DO; tk answer from a terminal resolves the same entry, first-wins, losers told who answered (D5). Completion reports land on the same chat, threading the original message. Human verdicts keep human provenance: the --from human attestation rule and the verdict guard apply unchanged, so an approval delivered this way is still a human verdict.

Diagnosis: tk ask and tk answer now consult the factory unconditionally, so paths that must degrade cleanly no longer do. Two behaviours regressed:
1. NOT-FOUND must stay exit 4. A question that does not exist locally is 'not found', not 'the factory errored' — a factory 404 must not be promoted into exit 6.
2. UNCONFIGURED must still park and exit 4. The pre-existing contract is that an unconfigured or incapable channel PARKS the tick and exits 4; a factory lookup failure is now turning that into exit 1.

The rule to restore: the factory is an ADDITIONAL delivery surface, never a precondition. If no factory is configured, or the factory 404s or is unreachable, tk ask and tk answer must behave exactly as they did before this tick. That is also what keeps the local-only, no-cloud path working — the design's degenerate case that must stay sacred.

Run 'go test -short -count=1 ./cmd/tk/...' in the FOREGROUND and read it before finishing.
acceptance_criteria: A gate parked by a cloud run reaches Telegram and blocks the run; answering from Telegram resumes it; answering the same gate from tk answer resolves it and the other surface reports already-answered; the resulting verdict carries human provenance and passes the verdict guard; an unpaired sender is dropped at the transport.
closed_reason: Completed: run gates delivered to Telegram through the RunRoom pending store with first-wins arbitration across phone and terminal, human provenance preserved for the verdict guard, and — after a gate-caught regression — the factory kept strictly optional: an absent, 404ing or unreachable factory leaves tk ask/tk answer behaving exactly as before, with regression tests pinning the exit codes.
